references.text: This verse contains the original instruction from God regarding the middle bar that was to run through the planks from end to end. Exodus 36:33 describes the execution of this command.
These verses describe the other crossbars made for the tabernacle's planks and provide the immediate context for the middle bar mentioned in verse 33.
This passage gives the complete instructions for all the crossbars of the tabernacle, including the middle bar, which Bezalel carried out in chapter 36.
This verse mentions the planks and crossbars as part of the components to be made for the tabernacle, showing the connection with the construction described in 36:33.
